name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (PMS-SC)
benefit: Financial assistance for SC students studying at post-matriculation level (class 11 onwards, including degree and PG courses). Yearly academic allowance depends on course group and hosteller/day-scholar status: Group 1 (Medicine, Engineering, Management, etc.): Rs 13,000 hostellers / Rs 7,000 day scholars; Group 2 (PG diplomas, CA/ICWA/CS etc.): Rs 9,500 / Rs 6,500; Group 3 (BA/BSc/BCom, MA/MSc/MCom): Rs 6,000 / Rs 3,000; Group 4 (other post-class-X non-degree courses): Rs 4,000 / Rs 2,500. Divyang (disabled) students get 10% extra allowance. Scholarship is disbursed through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
eligibility_rules: Candidate must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC)
Must have passed Matriculation (class 10), Higher Secondary or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education
Parents'/guardians' income from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 per annum
Studies must be in India; awardees are selected by the State/UT of the student's domicile
All children of the same parents/guardians are entitled to benefits (no sibling cap)
Students studying through correspondence or online courses are eligible for the scholarship (but not for the academic allowance)
exclusions: Students whose family income exceeds Rs 2,50,000 per annum are not eligible
Candidates studying in the same stage of education in a different subject after passing one stage (e.g. a second bachelor's degree) are not eligible
A scholarship holder under this scheme cannot hold any other scholarship or stipend at the same time
Students in correspondence/online courses do not receive the academic allowance
CA/ICWA/CS/ICFA students are treated as day scholars for the academic allowance (not hostellers)
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in): New applicants register under 'Applicant Corner' with mobile OTP, Aadhaar and bank details; then log in, select the scholarship, fill the form, upload documents and submit. Note: similar post-matric scholarship schemes exist for ST and OBC students with their own income ceilings.
source_document: myScheme page - Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
